## Install

Download `github-mcp.mcpb` below and double-click it. Claude Desktop will
walk you through:

1. **GitHub Personal Access Token** — paste a PAT with `repo` and
   `read:user` scopes (see
   [README](https://github.com/kyletaylored/github-mcp-server-mcpb#github-personal-access-token)
   for the full scope list). Generate one at
   <https://github.com/settings/tokens>.
2. **Install** — confirms and registers the GitHub MCP tools.

Requires `node` / `npx` on your `PATH`.
